do: Keep the quoted amount and make the case for the value: return, time saved, support included.
dont: Do not change the quoted amount in reply to the price objection.
guidance.summary: Learned from 198 previous deals at this decision point: when the seller changed the quoted amount after the buyer objected to the price, 30 of 92 closed won versus 58 of 106 otherwise (Fisher exact p = 0.0025).

knowledge.title: Hold the quoted amount after a price objection

do: Fold the changes into the earlier quote that is still open for this customer.
dont: Do not send a separate new quote while an earlier one to the same customer is still open.
guidance.summary: Learned from 150 previous deals at this decision point: when the seller sent a separate second quote while an earlier quote to the same customer was still open, 32 of 95 closed won versus 29 of 55 otherwise (Fisher exact p = 0.0258).

knowledge.title: Fold a new quote into the one still open

do: Send more outbound emails than the typical deal.
dont: Do not hold back on outbound email volume.
guidance.summary: Learned from 543 previous deals at this decision point: when the seller sent more outbound emails than the typical deal, 139 of 264 closed won versus 117 of 279 otherwise (Fisher exact p = 0.0128).

promotion_rule: two-sided Fisher exact test of won vs lost between deals that took the option and those that did not, each option with at least 20 previous deals; Benjamini-Hochberg across all 7 catalog hypotheses at q = 0.1; fixed before any run
